This implies that the market may be undervaluing this company. [E5] (bull) The stock sits 99% of the way up its 52-week range from a low of ₹177 to a high of ₹819. [E6] (bear) P/E ratio of 21.28x against a sector benchmark of 19.92x indicates that Beezaasan Explotech Ltd may be trading at a premium relative to its peers in terms of earnings valuation, which could suggest overvaluation. [E7] (bull) P/B ratio of 1.82x against a sector benchmark of 1.76x suggests that the company is undervalued compared to its book value, which can be an important factor for investors looking at balance sheet strength and asset quality. [E49] (bull) Screen reason (bull side): sales up QoQ indicates consistent positive growth in quarterly sales figures, suggesting a strong internal engine driving performance. [E56] (bull) Sector median sales growth is 22.2%, indicating that Beezaasan Explotech Ltd's sales growth rate of +11% over the trailing twelve months could be seen as above average within its sector, potentially justifying higher valuations. The company's strong sales growth rate is consistent with market expectations, and its undervalued P/B ratio suggests that investors may be overlooking its balance sheet strength.
